entities.name: EWSR1 (Q01844)
observations: Human EWS/EWSR1, 656 aa; exact sequence match to the supplied sequence.
Binds single-stranded RNA containing the consensus 5'-AGGUAA-3'.
May function as a transcriptional repressor and transcription coregulator.
Contains an N-terminal low-complexity Gly/Gln/Ser/Tyr-rich region, an RRM at residues 363–441, and a RanBP-type zinc-ribbon domain at residues 518–548.
Curated localization includes nucleus, nucleoplasm, Cajal bodies, cytoplasm, and plasma membrane; can relocalize from cytoplasm to ribosomes after PTK2B/FAK2 activation.
Interacts with RNA, POLR2C, SF1, calmodulin, PTK2B/FAK2, and TDRD3.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight approximately 68.5 kDa and theoretical pI approximately 9.37.

entities.name: EWSR1 RRM
observations: RNA-recognition motif (RRM_1; PF00076.29) detected at residues 363–441 with i-Evalue 1.5e-09.

entities.name: EWSR1 zinc ribbon
observations: RanBP-type zinc-ribbon domain (PF00641.24) detected at residues 518–548 with i-Evalue 1.1e-10.
Likely contributes to protein or nucleic-acid interaction architecture; exact molecular role is not established from this analysis alone.

entities.name: Transcription regulation
observations: EWSR1 is annotated as a transcription coregulator and may act as a transcriptional repressor.
EWSR1 can interact with POLR2C and may influence transcription initiation complexes.

entities.name: RNA metabolism
observations: EWSR1 binds single-stranded RNA and is associated with nuclear RNA-related compartments including Cajal bodies; cytoplasmic and ribosome-associated pools are also reported.
